display.purpose: Home-page hero only (full scale); every other hero uses the smaller .bl-hero--banner variant.

label.purpose: Anything that is a fact rather than prose: dates, prices, captions, nav links, table headers.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one high-commitment action per page — signal red, square, near-flat at rest.
components.html: Ready for this? Book a free call
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-family: 'Bitter', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; background: #a8362b; color: #f4efe4; border: 1px solid #a8362b; padding: 0.9em 1.6em; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(27,20,12,0.12); transition: transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease, background-color 0.15s ease; text-decoration: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(27,20,12,0.22); background: #8f2c22; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a8362b; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action — used per-tier on cards where the primary button would over-claim.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-family: 'Bitter', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.875rem; background: transparent; color: #1b2a3d; border: 1px solid rgba(27,42,61,0.22); padding: 0.55em 1.1em; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #a8362b; color: #a8362b; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Fixed, paper background, hairline border. Visible by default; hidden-then-reveal-on-scroll only on pages with a hero.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1em; padding: 1.1em 2.5em; background: #f4efe4; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(27,42,61,0.22); } .ds-nav__mark { font-family: 'Bitter', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; color: #1b2a3d; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav__links { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.75rem; } .ds-nav__links a { font-family: 'Spline Sans Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: #4a5773; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav__links a:hover { color: #a8362b; } .ds-nav__cta { color: #1b2a3d !important; border: 1px solid rgba(27,42,61,0.22); padding: 0.55em 1.1em; } .ds-nav__cta:hover { border-color: #a8362b; color: #a8362b !important; }

components.name: Hero Heading
components.description: Full-bleed real photograph, dark scrim, bottom-anchored headline with signal-red (or, on the home page only, dusty-rose) em emphasis.
components.html: Scottish island strategy retreats for teams, and remote coaching for people feeling stuck.
components.css: .ds-hero { position: relative; min-height: 420px; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; background: #1b2a3d center/cover no-repeat; padding: 2rem; overflow: hidden; } .ds-hero__scrim { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(14,20,28,0.88), rgba(14,20,28,0.1) 68%); } .ds-hero__title { position: relative; z-index: 2; font-family: 'Bitter', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: clamp(1.9rem, 5vw, 3.5rem); line-height: 1.1; color: #f4efe4; margin: 0; text-shadow: 0 2px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); } .ds-hero__title em { font-style: normal; color: #e0a999; }

components.name: Comparison Table
components.description: Pricing/tier data rendered as an actual ledger — mono figures, hairline rows, no zebra striping.
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-family: 'Spline Sans Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-table th, .ds-table td { text-align: left; padding: 0.6em 1em 0.6em 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(27,42,61,0.22); } .ds-table thead th { font-family: 'Bitter', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; color: #1b2a3d; font-size: 0.8125rem; } .ds-table tbody th { color: #4a5773; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Checklist Item
components.description: Rotated-square (diamond) bullet in signal red — deliberately abstract, not a checkmark icon.
components.html: • Problem space work. Mornings are spent collaboratively building maps of our problem spaces.
components.css: .ds-list { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 1.75rem; } .ds-list li { position: relative; padding-left: 2em; } .ds-list li::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0.55em; width: 0.55em; height: 0.55em; background: #a8362b; transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-list strong { display: block; font-family: 'Bitter', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; color: #1b2a3d; } .ds-list span { color: #4a5773; }

components.css: .ds-faq { border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(27,42,61,0.22); padding: 1rem 0; } .ds-faq summary { cursor: pointer; list-style: none; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-family: 'Bitter', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; color: #1b2a3d; } .ds-faq summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-faq__icon { color: #a8362b; transition: transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-faq[open] .ds-faq__icon { transform: rotate(180deg); } .ds-faq__body { color: #4a5773; padding-top: 0.4em; }

components.css: .ds-entry { padding: 1.75rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(27,42,61,0.22); max-width: 40rem; } .ds-entry__date { font-family: 'Spline Sans Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #4a5773; } .ds-entry__title { font-family: 'Bitter', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.25rem; margin: 0.4em 0; } .ds-entry__title a { color: #1b2a3d; text-decoration: none; } .ds-entry__title a:hover { color: #a8362b; } .ds-entry__excerpt { color: #4a5773; margin: 0; }

narrative.overview: This system exists to prove one idea: clarity isn't a mood, it's a decision. A shipping forecast doesn't inspire you — it gives you exactly what you need to make a confident go/no-go call, in the same terse, structured form every time. That's the register this whole site now speaks in: pale bulletin paper, navy ink, hairline rules, tabular data rendered as an actual ledger rather than a bulleted list pretending to be one. Where something needs to matter, it gets the one signal-red accent this system permits itself. Everywhere else, the paper and the ink do the work. It replaced an earlier, wrong-headed attempt at the same brief — a dark, bioluminescent night-sea world that was technically accomplished but fought the brand's real asset: bright, documentary daylight photography of an actual place.
keyCharacteristics: Pale bulletin paper throughout — no page in this system uses a dark ground.
Exactly one accent colour (signal red), spent deliberately: primary actions, em emphasis inside headings, and nothing else.
Every corner in the system is square. Zero border-radius anywhere except unavoidable native browser chrome.
Three typefaces with distinct jobs, never substituted for each other: slab display, humanist serif for reading, monospace for anything that is data.
Real photography only. No page in this system carries an illustrative, AI-generated, or stock image as a hero.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Signal red is the only colour in the system that means something when you see it. It never appears as a decorative field or a colour choice made for variety.

rules.name: The Hero Exception
rules.body: The hero's em emphasis uses #e0a999 (dusty rose), not signal red — confined to .bl-hero__title em, chosen because it reads better against warm photographic skies.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-Data Rule
rules.body: Spline Sans Mono is never used for opinion or narrative — only for things that are factually true regardless of who's reading.

rules.name: The Hairline-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Depth and separation come from a 1px rule at 22% ink opacity, not from a shadow. Reach for a border first.

rules.name: The Square Corner Rule
rules.body: No component may introduce border-radius without a named reason strong enough to be documented. Native browser chrome is the only exempted rounding.

dos: Do spend signal red only on primary actions and em emphasis.
Do use real, documentary photography for every hero.
Do use the mono face for facts and the serif for prose, without mixing the two roles.
donts: Don't add a kicker or eyebrow label above a heading — caught and removed twice during this system's build before it shipped either time.
Don't introduce a second sticky sidebar without the same justification the podcast archive's Subscribe sidebar was built for.
Don't use box-shadow for resting-state depth — reserved for the primary button's hover state only.
Don't substitute Unicode glyphs or emoji for an icon.
